title: scutellaria elliptica var. hirsuta
intro: Scutellaria elliptica var. hirsuta, commonly known as hairy skullcap, is a plant species in the mint family that is native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of hairy skullcap include acting as an adaptogen, anxiolytic, and antioxidant, which can help alleviate stress, anxiety, and oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of hairy skullcap include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
